name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after a brief stint as a local journalist covering regional racing events. His innate ability to craft compelling narratives and build rapport with drivers and team personnel quickly became apparent. Recognizing his talent, a smaller GT team offered him a role managing their media relations. 

He firmly believes that effective PR is about more than just press releases; it’s about fostering genuine connections with fans and stakeholders. Jean-Pierre excels at crafting personalized stories that highlight the human element of racing, from the drivers' dedication to the mechanics' unsung efforts. His detail-oriented nature ensures that every communication is polished and impactful, contributing to a positive public image for Herberth Motorsport.

Jean-Pierre is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to think creatively when faced with challenging PR scenarios. He's not afraid to push boundaries and try new approaches, always striving to elevate Herberth Motorsport's brand.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen wearing stylish but practical clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a peculiar fondness for herbal tea and drinks it throughout the day.
Insists on proofreading every communication, no matter how small.
